agmarknet.name: Daily Market Prices of Commodity India (Agmarknet Mirror)
agmarknet.source_organization: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
agmarknet.coverage: Daily commodity prices and arrivals, multiple states, 2001–2025
agmarknet.purpose_in_kisansetu: Demand scoring for congestion engine; mandi arrival patterns inform seasonal demand index; historical modal prices provide market context for procurement
agmarknet.refresh_method: Re-run download_agmarknet.py; Kaggle dataset updated periodically by publisher

msp.name: Minimum Support Price — CACP Official Tables
msp.source_organization: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP), DA&FW, Government of India
msp.download_url: Embedded reference data in scripts/download_msp.py; live from upag.gov.in
msp.purpose_in_kisansetu: Payment calculation: Accepted Quantity × MSP = Farmer Payment. Seeds Crop.msp_per_quintal in the database. Powers get_msp() lookup function.
msp.refresh_method: Update embedded data in download_msp.py when CACP announces new season MSPs (typically June for Kharif, October for Rabi)

fci.name: FCI State-wise Foodgrain Procurement Data
fci.source_organization: Food Corporation of India (FCI), Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
fci.download_url: Embedded reference from FCI Annual Reports; live attempt via upag.gov.in
fci.coverage: Wheat and Paddy procurement, state-wise, 2020-21 to 2023-24
fci.purpose_in_kisansetu: Procurement demand index: high-procurement states get higher demand scores in congestion engine. Powers seasonal demand modelling and slot recommendation weighting.
fci.refresh_method: Update embedded data in download_fci.py after each FCI Annual Report release

pincodes.name: India Pincode Directory (Post Office / District / State)
pincodes.source_organization: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, Government of India
pincodes.coverage: All India pincode directory — 6-digit pincodes with post office, district, state
pincodes.purpose_in_kisansetu: Location seed data for realistic procurement centre addresses. Geographic distribution for synthetic demo data. No personal addresses.
pincodes.pii_status: NO_PII — post office level only, no individual addresses
pincodes.refresh_method: Re-run download_pincodes.py annually or when postal reorganizations occur

enam.name: eNAM Mandi Reference Data
enam.source_organization: National Agriculture Market (eNAM), Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
enam.download_url: Curated reference list compiled from enam.gov.in public data
enam.purpose_in_kisansetu: Candidate location seed data for demo procurement centres. Clearly labeled MANDI_REFERENCE_DATA — not operational procurement centre data.
enam.refresh_method: Update fetch_enam_reference.py as new mandis join eNAM platform
enam.data_type_note: Records are labeled MANDI_REFERENCE_DATA. Not all mandis are FCI procurement centres.
